# Dust and sea-salt ions in Greenland ic: # Complexity of Holocene climate as reconstructed from a Greenland ice core
# File: NOAA NCEI paleo/icecore/greenland/summit/gisp2/chem/iond.txt (public domain). Ages are years before 1950.
# Calcium (Ca) is the usual sign of continental dust; Mg and K also come partly from soil dust. Year = 1950 - age BP (middle of each sample).
# The US Dust Bowl (about 1930-1940) was reported in Greenland ice from dust-particle analysis by Donarummo
# Geophysical Research Letters 30(6):1269. In these ion samples calcium is only a little higher in 1927-1936 (9-11 ppb against an 8 ppb average).
